_doc: Banned-faction registry: the FactionDefs the owner does not want in the game. Data, read by src/RimMandrake/Utils/banned_factions.py (check-repo / check-save / check-dump) and its selftest. Design and the engine mechanisms behind every field: design/RimMandrake/factions_unwanted_and_lingering_2026-10-20.md. To ban another faction: add an entry here, then make the def carry the 'banish' field values (our own def: edit it; anyone else's: add a guarded block to the patch file named below), then run python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/selftest_banned_factions.py.

banish._doc: What every banned def must say once loaded. hidden: off the Factions tab, comms console, AllFactionsVisible quest pickers, neutral arrivals (traders, visitors, travelers), worldgen settlement placement, and ShouldHaveLeader (no null-leader ErrorOnce); HasGoodwill false, so goodwill can no longer move it to hostile. raidsForbidden: out of PawnGroupMakerUtility.UsableFactions, the enemy-raid pool, which hidden does NOT block (IncidentWorker_RaidEnemy passes allowHidden:true). startingCountAtWorldCreation 0 + maxConfigurableAtWorldCreation 0: not on the Configure Factions page at all (deliberate here, unlike OnlyOurFactions.xml, which must keep rows). requiredCountAtGameStart 0: not generated on the no-page worldgen path, and VEF faction discovery skips a hidden def whose required count is 0. canGenerateQuestSites false: QuestNode_Root_DistressCall and QuestNode_Root_WorkSite walk AllFactionsListForReading with no hidden or defeated test, and this flag is their only gate.

factions.why_kept_loadable: loadID 9 in all four ASHKARR_DEV_* saves (2026-10-20): deleting the def before those saves are re-made drops the faction on load with 'Some factions were null after loading' and leaves dangling references from every other faction's relations.
factions.delete_def_when: no save we keep holds it (check-save reports ABSENT on every keeper), i.e. after the world re-make
factions.owner: 2026-10-20: "I notice in factions there are Tallmere Combs and Sacrileg Hunters however. We don't want those... same with the Space Exchange."

factions.why_kept_loadable: Every DLC is a prerequisite, and BackCompatibility.FactionManagerPostLoadInit re-creates a TradersGuild faction on EVERY load when none exists, whatever the def says. Removing it is impossible; banishing the instance in place is the only stable state.
factions.extra: Core's four orbital trader kinds name it as their faction (Orbital_BulkGoods, Orbital_CombatSupplier, Orbital_Exotic, Orbital_PirateMerchant); the patch removes that <faction> so trade ships arrive factionless, as before Odyssey.

factions.seen_as: The Celestial Rogues (generated name, NamerFactionSalvagers); label 'salvagers'
factions.why_kept_loadable: Every DLC is a prerequisite, and BackCompatibility.FactionManagerPostLoadInit re-creates a Salvagers faction (FactionDefOf.Salvagers, on the Orbit layer) on EVERY load when none exists, whatever the def says. Banishing the instance in place is the only stable state. Odyssey C# also reads the instance: QuestNode_Root_OrbitalFugitive generates Salvager_Elite and a Combat group with Faction.OfSalvagers; GenStepDefs OrbitalFugitivePlatform and Opportunity_OrbitalWreck_Salvagers name factionDef Salvagers. The def banish does not stop those pawns; the routes are cut separately, see content_cut.

content_cut._doc: Content that spawns a banned faction's PAWNS directly, which the def banish does not gate (hidden/defeated do not stop pawn generation). Each route is closed by a guarded op in patch_file; check-repo asserts the op exists, check-dump asserts the loaded def and sweeps every GenStepDef and ThingSetMakerDef for any other route. Found by scanning def dump 2026-10-21T04-26-37Z for every def naming the faction or one of pawn_kinds, plus RimSage C# (Faction.OfSalvagers, PawnKindDefOf.Salvager_Elite: only QuestNode_Root_OrbitalFugitive and BackCompatibility).
content_cut.owner: 2026-10-20, by question card: 'Odyssey orbital fugitive quest and salvager wreck sites still spawn Celestial Rogues pawns; keep?' -> 'Cut them'

gensteps_unreachable.OrbitalFugitivePlatform: linked to the OrbitalFugitivePlatform site part, which only the OrbitalFugitive quest creates; that quest's weight is 0
